name.description: The name of the early access feature.

description.description: A longer description of what this early access feature does, shown to users in the opt-in UI.

stage.description:
Lifecycle stage. Valid values: draft, concept, alpha, beta, general-availability, archived. Moving to an active stage (alpha/beta/general-availability) enables the feature flag for opted-in users.

* `draft` - draft
* `concept` - concept
* `alpha` - alpha
* `beta` - beta
* `general-availability` - general availability
* `archived` - archived

documentation_url.description: URL to external documentation for this feature. Shown to users in the opt-in UI.

payload.description: Feature flag payload for this early access feature
